---
name: scenario-evidence
description: Run a versioned Runtime scenario, probe its real capabilities, preserve compact evidence, and prepare its native review target. Use for a project outcome that benefits from repeatable setup/run/assertion/evidence—not to choose a plan, team, or business verdict.
---

# Scenario evidence

Use the scenario package already owned by the project. A package is ordinary files and native tools;
it is not a replacement for Work, Git, project services, or lead judgement.

1. Read the package's `scenario.json`, project instructions and source inputs. Identify what the run can
   mechanically prove and what still needs a lead or owner to judge.
2. Probe first:

   ```sh
   restless-scenario doctor <package-directory>
   ```

   Treat a missing required capability as `blocked`. Do not substitute a host executable, a fake
   success, or a narrative claim.
3. Choose a fresh output directory outside the package and run the exact scenario:

   ```sh
   restless-scenario run <package-directory> \
     --output /company/outputs/<scenario>-<run-id> \
     --seed <recorded-seed>
   ```

   The runner writes `run-manifest.json`, phase logs and declared evidence there. It neither chooses
   the project strategy nor performs external effects.
4. Inspect the native review target named by the manifest. A `verified` mechanical result is not a
   product, game, operational or commercial acceptance. State the exact judgement still requested.
5. When this is Work output, link the manifest and the selected native target through the existing
   `restless work artifact` command, tied to the current Attempt. Do not create an ad hoc scenario
   database or claim the output replaced the candidate.

For game work, use the installed `godot` only after `doctor` observes it. Preserve input/network
profiles, client/server logs, exported build and a prepared image/video/native target. For non-code
work, preserve the source inputs, deterministic validation report, rendered output and the human
readiness question. Controlled `_test` input proves the workflow mechanism only; it never proves
customer demand, real operations, gameplay fun, or an external provider effect.

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — playable local session (review target).
# Opens two rendered windows: HOST then a joining CLIENT, over ENet on 127.0.0.1:24565.
# Controls (each window): WASD move (through cab<->cargo doorway), E interact
# (pick up / release crate near hands, or take driver seat), W/S while driving
# moves the truck along the bounded route. Release the crate behind the truck
# inside the marked DESTINATION ZONE to complete the delivery (host-authoritative).
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"
: "${DISPLAY:?:a display is required; e.g. DISPLAY=:1 $0}"
echo "== starting HOST window on DISPLAY=$DISPLAY"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=$DISPLAY "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- --host &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "== starting CLIENT window"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=$DISPLAY "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- --client &
CLIENT_PID=$!
trap 'kill $HOST_PID $CLIENT_PID 2>/dev/null || true' INT TERM
echo "== session running; Ctrl+C to close both."
wait

# Local agent playtest

`playtest.sh` is the player-like regression lane for this project. It starts
the rendered host and client, focuses the real client X11 window, and sends

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival native-input playtest. This deliberately drives the rendered
# Godot client through X11 (xdotool keyboard + real mouse motion) rather than
# touching Godot input/state APIs. The game records its own event screenshots
# (--shots); scrot/ffmpeg are absent in this Runtime.
#
# The run includes one deliberate mistake (Q drops the crate right after
# pickup) and its recovery (E picks it back up), then the full delivery loop:
# walk cargo->cab through the doorway, drive the bounded route, leave the
# seat, turn around with the mouse, walk out of the rear, unload in the zone.
set -eu

DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)"
OUT="${1:-/company/outputs/exp11/playtests/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:1}"
export DISPLAY
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME" "$OUT/shots"

TRACE="$OUT/input-trace.tsv"
HOST_LOG="$OUT/host.log"
CLIENT_LOG="$OUT/client.log"

printf 'at\taction\n' > "$TRACE"
mark() { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$1" >> "$TRACE"; }
hold() { mark "keydown:$1"; xdotool keydown "$1"; sleep "$2"; xdotool keyup "$1"; mark "keyup:$1"; }
tap() { mark "tap:$1"; xdotool key "$1"; sleep 1; }
mouse_turn() { mark "mousemove_relative:$1"; xdotool mousemove_relative -- $1; sleep 0.4; }

command -v xdotool >/dev/null

HOME="$GODOT_HOME" "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- --host --shots="$OUT/shots" >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
HOME="$GODOT_HOME" "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- --client --shots="$OUT/shots" >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!
cleanup() { kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sleep 4

# Focus the client for keyboard input without moving/capturing the pointer;
# startup yaw therefore remains deterministic for the route below.
CLIENT_WINDOW="$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'CLIENT' | tail -n 1)"
[ -n "$CLIENT_WINDOW" ]
xdotool windowactivate --sync "$CLIENT_WINDOW"
mark "focused-client:$CLIENT_WINDOW"

# Deliberate mistake and recovery, as real keyboard input.
tap e          # pick up the crate at the cargo spawn
tap q          # MISTAKE: drop it on the bed
tap e          # RECOVERY: pick it back up
mark "mistake+recovery:e,q,e"

# Carry it to the cab through the doorway and take the driver seat.
hold w 1.9
tap e
# Drive the bounded route to its end (3 m/s, 40 m).
hold w 14.5
# Leave at the rear cargo threshold. Take a short backward step down the real
# ramp into the yellow zone; unlike the former cab-side exit this path cannot
# collide with or immediately re-trigger the driver seat.
tap e
hold s 0.70
# Capture pointer and send a native mouse event while remaining inside the
# generous unload zone, then use the HUD-promoted E action.
xdotool mousemove --window "$CLIENT_WINDOW" 640 400
xdotool click 1
mouse_turn "80 0"
tap e
sleep 2
mark "done"

grep -q 'RESOLVED grab' "$HOST_LOG" || { echo 'no grab resolved on host' >&2; exit 1; }
grep -q 'RESOLVED drop' "$HOST_LOG" || { echo 'mistake drop not resolved on host' >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -c 'RESOLVED grab' "$HOST_LOG")" -ge 2 ] || { echo 'mistake recovery (re-grab) not observed on host' >&2; exit 1; }
grep -q 'HOST completed delivery' "$HOST_LOG" || { echo 'native-input playtest did not observe host delivery completion' >&2; exit 1; }
grep -q 'DELIVERY COMPLETED' "$CLIENT_LOG" || { echo 'native-input playtest did not observe client delivery completion' >&2; exit 1; }

{
	echo "native X11 input delivery: VERIFIED"
	echo "mistake: Q drop right after pickup; recovery: E re-grab (host resolved 2 grabs + 1 drop before delivery)"
	echo "controls exercised: E interact, Q drop, W/S walk/drive, native mousemove_relative look"
	echo "screenshots: game-side event captures (ev_*) and 5s interval frames (seq_*) in shots/"
} > "$OUT/result.txt"
echo "playtest bundle: $OUT"

turn() { mark "mousemove_relative:$1"; xdotool mousemove_relative -- $1; sleep 0.5; }

trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sleep 4

xdotool windowactivate --sync "$CLIENT_WINDOW"

tap e

xdotool mousemove --window "$CLIENT_WINDOW" 640 400
xdotool click 1

turn "1256 0"

tap e

find "$OUT/shots" -type f -name '*ev_reject_journey*.png' | grep -q . || { echo 'journey rejection screenshot missing' >&2; exit 1; }

{
	echo "native X11 on-foot route-zero bypass: REJECTED"

	echo "screenshots: game-side event capture ev_reject_journey*.png plus interval frames in shots/"
} > "$OUT/result.txt"
echo "bypass playtest bundle: $OUT"

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — focused repeatable verification probe.
# Launches one host and one joining client (Godot high-level multiplayer / ENet),
# both in scripted autopilot, headless. Exit code 0 = full delivery loop observed
# on BOTH processes: join, hand-interaction pickup, drive bounded route, unload in
# marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion, clean shutdown.
#
# Hardened:
#   1. Pre-launch headless GDScript parse validation (validate-scripts.sh).
#      Parse errors abort BEFORE any process is spawned.
#   2. Overall wall-time timeout (default 90s, override with PROBE_TIMEOUT).
#      If host or client fails to write 'PROBE RESULT: PASS' within the bound,
#      both processes are killed, logs are stamped FAIL, and the script exits
#      nonzero. A clean passing run still exits 0.
#
# Usage: run-probe.sh [--positive|--negative|--mechanics|--recovery|--seat-recovery] <host-log> <client-log> [shots-dir]
# Declared Work-gate aliases: --journey-positive, --journey-bypass,
# --seat-recovery, --mechanics-recovery (the last runs mechanics + recovery).
#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --seat-recovery)
        # Dedicated acceptance name for the recovery lane. Dispatch only to
        # the existing recovery probe; never forward an unknown game flag.
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --recovery"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    exit 2
fi

HOST_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --host"
CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --client"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && HOST_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — focused repeatable verification probe.
# Launches one host and one joining client (Godot high-level multiplayer / ENet),
# both in scripted autopilot, headless. Exit code 0 = full delivery loop observed
# on BOTH processes: join, hand-interaction pickup, drive bounded route, unload in
# marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion, clean shutdown.
#
# Hardened:
#   1. Pre-launch headless GDScript parse validation (validate-scripts.sh).
#      Parse errors abort BEFORE any process is spawned.
#   2. Overall wall-time timeout (default 90s, override with PROBE_TIMEOUT).
#      If host or client fails to write 'PROBE RESULT: PASS' within the bound,
#      both processes are killed, logs are stamped FAIL, and the script exits
#      nonzero. A clean passing run still exits 0.
#
# Usage: run-probe.sh [--positive|--negative|--mechanics|--recovery|--seat-recovery] <host-log> <client-log> [shots-dir]
# Declared Work-gate aliases: --journey-positive, --journey-bypass,
# --seat-recovery, --mechanics-recovery (the last runs mechanics + recovery).
#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --seat-recovery)
        # Dedicated acceptance name for the recovery lane. Dispatch only to
        # the existing recovery probe; never forward an unknown game flag.
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --recovery"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    exit 2
fi

HOST_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --host"
CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --client"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && HOST_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && CLIENT_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --client --shots=$SHOTS"

echo "== host: $GODOT $HOST_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $HOST_ARGS >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "== client: $GODOT $CLIENT_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $CLIENT_ARGS >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!

# Overall watchdog: kills both processes if the bound elapses.
( sleep "$TIMEOUT" && kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null ) &
WATCHDOG=$!

TIMED_OUT=0
set +e
wait $HOST_PID; HOST_RC=$?
wait $CLIENT_PID; CLIENT_RC=$?
set -e
kill "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true

# Distinguish watchdog kill (128+15) from a genuine run; check PASS markers.
HOST_PASS=0; CLIENT_PASS=0
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$HOST_LOG" && HOST_PASS=1
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$CLIENT_LOG" && CLIENT_PASS=1

if [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 143 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 143 ]; then
    TIMED_OUT=1
fi
# Belt and braces: no PASS marker after $TIMEOUT of wall time means failure even
# if the processes happened to exit on their own first.
if [ "$HOST_PASS" -eq 0 ] || [ "$CLIENT_PASS" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$TIMED_OUT" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "== TIMEOUT: no PASS within ${TIMEOUT}s; both processes killed." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    else
        echo "== FAIL: process ended without PASS (host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC)." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    fi
    echo "== FAIL: host log = $HOST_LOG ; client log = $CLIENT_LOG" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "== host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC"
echo "== PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DIR=/company/worktrees/work-731bd86c6507-r1
OUT=/company/outputs/swift-arrival-r15-final-independent-b8e3161f/re-entry
GODOT=/usr/local/bin/godot
DISPLAY=:1
export DISPLAY
export GODOT_HOME=/tmp/godot-home-b8e3161f-reentry
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME" "$OUT/shots"
TRACE="$OUT/input-trace.tsv"
HOST_LOG="$OUT/host.log"
CLIENT_LOG="$OUT/client.log"
printf 'at\taction\n' > "$TRACE"
mark() { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$1" >> "$TRACE"; }
hold() { mark "keydown:$1"; xdotool keydown "$1"; sleep "$2"; xdotool keyup "$1"; mark "keyup:$1"; }
tap() { mark "tap:$1"; xdotool key "$1"; sleep 1; }
HOME="$GODOT_HOME" "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- --host --shots="$OUT/shots" >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
HOME="$GODOT_HOME" "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- --client --shots="$OUT/shots" >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!
cleanup() { kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sleep 4
HOST_WINDOW="$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'HOST' | sed -n '$p')"
CLIENT_WINDOW="$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'CLIENT' | sed -n '$p')"
[ -n "$HOST_WINDOW" ]
[ -n "$CLIENT_WINDOW" ]
printf 'role\twindow_id\tname\tgeometry\n' > "$OUT/window-routing.tsv"
printf 'host\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$HOST_WINDOW" "$(xdotool getwindowname "$HOST_WINDOW")" "$(xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$HOST_WINDOW" | tr '\n' ' ')" >> "$OUT/window-routing.tsv"
printf 'client\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$CLIENT_WINDOW" "$(xdotool getwindowname "$CLIENT_WINDOW")" "$(xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$CLIENT_WINDOW" | tr '\n' ' ')" >> "$OUT/window-routing.tsv"
xdotool windowactivate --sync "$CLIENT_WINDOW"
mark "focused-client:$CLIENT_WINDOW"
tap e
hold w 1.9
tap e
hold w 4.0
tap e
mark "deliberate-early-exit"
hold w 2.0
tap e
mark "natural-seat-reentry"
sleep 3
[ "$(grep -c 'occupies DRIVER position' "$HOST_LOG")" -ge 2 ]
grep -q 'left driver position at rear cargo threshold' "$HOST_LOG"
grep -q 'SEATED — W/S drive' "$CLIENT_LOG"
grep -q 'EXITED EARLY — re-enter' "$CLIENT_LOG"
[ "$(grep -c 'SEATED — W/S drive' "$CLIENT_LOG")" -ge 2 ]
if grep -q 'HOST completed delivery' "$HOST_LOG"; then
  echo 'unexpected completion during early-exit recovery route' >&2
  exit 1
fi
{
  echo 'native X11 early-exit recovery: VERIFIED'
  echo 'ordinary input: E pickup, W approach, E seat, W partial drive, E early exit, W through cargo, E natural re-entry'
  echo 'authoritative result: host observed early exit and second DRIVER occupancy; client received truthful early-exit guidance and second SEATED feedback'
} > "$OUT/result.txt"
echo "re-entry playtest bundle: $OUT"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DIR=/company/worktrees/work-731bd86c6507-r1
OUT=/company/outputs/swift-arrival-r15-final-independent-b8e3161f/re-entry
GODOT=/usr/local/bin/godot
DISPLAY=:1
export DISPLAY
export GODOT_HOME=/tmp/godot-home-b8e3161f-reentry
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME" "$OUT/shots"
TRACE="$OUT/input-trace.tsv"
HOST_LOG="$OUT/host.log"
CLIENT_LOG="$OUT/client.log"
printf 'at\taction\n' > "$TRACE"
mark() { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$1" >> "$TRACE"; }
hold() { mark "keydown:$1"; xdotool keydown "$1"; sleep "$2"; xdotool keyup "$1"; mark "keyup:$1"; }
tap() { mark "tap:$1"; xdotool key "$1"; sleep 1; }
HOME="$GODOT_HOME" "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- --host --shots="$OUT/shots" >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
HOME="$GODOT_HOME" "$GODOT" --path "$DIR" --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- --client --shots="$OUT/shots" >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!
cleanup() { kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sleep 4
HOST_WINDOW="$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'HOST' | sed -n '$p')"
CLIENT_WINDOW="$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'CLIENT' | sed -n '$p')"
[ -n "$HOST_WINDOW" ]
[ -n "$CLIENT_WINDOW" ]
printf 'role\twindow_id\tname\tgeometry\n' > "$OUT/window-routing.tsv"
printf 'host\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$HOST_WINDOW" "$(xdotool getwindowname "$HOST_WINDOW")" "$(xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$HOST_WINDOW" | tr '\n' ' ')" >> "$OUT/window-routing.tsv"
printf 'client\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$CLIENT_WINDOW" "$(xdotool getwindowname "$CLIENT_WINDOW")" "$(xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$CLIENT_WINDOW" | tr '\n' ' ')" >> "$OUT/window-routing.tsv"
xdotool windowactivate --sync "$CLIENT_WINDOW"
mark "focused-client:$CLIENT_WINDOW"
tap e
hold w 1.9
tap e
hold w 4.0
tap e
mark "deliberate-early-exit"
hold w 2.0
tap e
mark "natural-seat-reentry"
sleep 3
[ "$(grep -c 'occupies DRIVER position' "$HOST_LOG")" -ge 2 ]
grep -q 'left driver position at rear cargo threshold' "$HOST_LOG"
grep -q 'SEATED — W/S drive' "$CLIENT_LOG"
grep -q 'EXITED EARLY — re-enter' "$CLIENT_LOG"
[ "$(grep -c 'SEATED — W/S drive' "$CLIENT_LOG")" -ge 2 ]
if grep -q 'HOST completed delivery' "$HOST_LOG"; then
  echo 'unexpected completion during early-exit recovery route' >&2
  exit 1
fi
{
  echo 'native X11 early-exit recovery: VERIFIED'
  echo 'ordinary input: E pickup, W approach, E seat, W partial drive, E early exit, W through cargo, E natural re-entry'
  echo 'authoritative result: host observed early exit and second DRIVER occupancy; client received truthful early-exit guidance and second SEATED feedback'
} > "$OUT/result.txt"
echo "re-entry playtest bundle: $OUT"
